release_notes_summary: Searle New friction, Super Ped low/high formulas and Show Work, and angle/carry validation fixes.
notes: Searle (New) uses asphalt friction 0.66 without dynamic adjustment and 0.70 with it. Custom friction is used as entered.
Super Ped Entry now uses the standalone Searle (New) low/high equations, including vehicle and pedestrian weights and explicit carry subtraction, with the full substitution trace in Show Work.
Negative or excessive carry distances and takeoff angles outside 0 to less than 90 degrees are rejected.
Existing method limitations remain visible, including the off-axis method marked "Experimental - physical validation pending; not qualified for casework use."
Internal-only reference materials remain excluded; the public bundle retains the previously approved reference allowlist.
The five guidance clarifications document the selected friction basis, carry assumption, and angle evidence without changing formulas, defaults, or input keys.
Software verification does not establish physical validation.
Greg Russell's spreadsheet comparison remains pending; this release does not claim that audit is complete.
Stable build source snapshot SHA-256 after the five documented help-text clarifications: 3248fd81d0bb012e312f14a91866696c7c258d0ca49760e4557ce8efd2171090.
Focused pedestrian scope: 58 tests passed on the tested local candidate. After the five help-text clarifications, 32 focused instruction-guidance and Searle regression tests passed.
Official candidate and installed smokes passed on the tested local candidate. Native artifact-verified Searle and Super Pedestrian round trips passed in the supplied smoke evidence.

The stable package was built from the updated staged snapshot; unchanged compiled app modules match the tested local candidate. The approved 0.9.7 reference files and standard-library archive bytes are retained.
